composition_subtypes.role: Sort boys' personal money and bike prices to enable optimal pairing
Check feasibility of k by pairing richest boys with cheapest bikes to minimize shared budget

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort arrays, binary search on k using greedy check that pairs top-k boys with cheapest k bikes to minimize shared budget needed.
payload.rationale: The solution uses sorting to order data and a greedy exchange-argument-based check to decide feasibility within a binary search. Sorting and greedy are distinct coordinated mechanisms.
